description: This Java source file defines the CachedNamespaceInvalidator class, which is an Akka actor responsible for invalidating cache entries associated with blocked namespaces. It manages cache invalidation logic based on changes observed in distributed sets of blocked namespaces, utilizing Akka's actor model, timers, and clustering features.

classes.name: CachedNamespaceInvalidator
classes.description: An Akka actor that listens for changes in blocked namespace sets and invalidates cache entries related to those namespaces. Uses timers for delayed invalidation and integrates with Akka cluster data structures.

classes.name: InvalidateCachedNamespaces
classes.description: Internal class encapsulating the set of namespaces to be invalidated in a cache invalidation event.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for an instance of CachedNamespaceInvalidator, specifying blocked namespaces and caches to maintain.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Sets up the message handling logic for the actor, including handling of Replicator changes, invalidation commands, and unhandled messages.

methods.name: logUnhandled
methods.description: Logs a warning for messages that are not explicitly handled by this actor.

methods.name: handleChanged
methods.description: Processes changes from the Akka Replicator, identifies namespace sets, and schedules cache invalidation.

methods.name: logNamespaces
methods.description: Logs the namespaces received or to be invalidated, with different levels of detail based on size.

methods.name: invalidateNamespacesAfterDelay
methods.description: Schedules cache invalidation after a fixed delay to prevent race conditions.

methods.name: invalidateCachedNamespaces
methods.description: Performs the actual cache invalidation for the provided set of namespaces.

methods.name: invalidateNamespaces
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries that belong to specific namespaces.

methods.name: containsNamespaceOfEntityId
methods.description: Checks if an entity's namespace belongs to the set of blocked namespaces.
